test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 28 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: In an election between two candidates, 10% of voters didn’t participate in voting, 20% votes were declared invalid and the winner got 70% of the total valid votes and won by 6480 votes. Find the total number of votes in the voting list.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let **total votes** be x.

Valid votes = x × (9/10) × (4/5) = 18x/25.

Winning margin = (70% − 30%) = 40% of **valid votes**.

⇒ (18x/25) × (2/5) = 6480.

⇒ x = (6480 × 125) / 36 = 180 × 125 = 22500.

**∴ The correct answer is 22,500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ca6057926ca1673b8f2267040039edd79c1902d30086a7cb5e6d58c1fcd1ecf.png] 

**Given:** Winner got 70% of **valid votes**, Loser got 30%.

**Difference:** 70% − 30% = 40% of valid votes = 6480.

⇒ Total **Valid Votes** = (6480 / 40) × 100 = 16200.

⇒ **Voted Votes** (80% are valid) = (16200 / 80) × 100 = 20250.

⇒ **Total Votes** (90% participated) = (20250 / 90) × 100 = 22500.

**∴ The correct answer is 22,500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Election Base Calculations

Always identify the base: **Valid votes** are calculated after removing non-voters and invalid votes from the **total voting list**.

Winning Margin Rule

Margin = (Winner% − Loser%) × Total Valid Votes. In a two-candidate election, Loser% = 100% − Winner%.

Successive Percentage

Effective Valid Votes = Total × (Participated%) × (Valid%). Use fractions for faster calculation (e.g., 80% = 4/5).</p
